A.name: Gera
A.notes: from the list of "sons of Israel" who "went to Egypt" (GEN 46:8-27)
family: son-of benjamin (Benjamin, twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (GEN 35:18))

B.name: Gera
B.line: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin, in the Chronicles genealogy.

why: The Hebrew names one Gera among Bela’s sons, matching B’s stated genealogy. However, A also explicitly identifies Gera as Bela’s son in this verse, so the supplied text and facts cannot distinguish the two records.
